title: Ootlejuice Candy Summoner
summary: A privacy-themed candy-game entry for the October build contest. At our October 10, 2026 review, the linked GitHub repository contained a README, with no homepage or releases listed. No demo link was found in that repository or the complete contest thread checked; the creator’s post said a demo video was coming. This observation is limited to those sources and may change. November 2 organizer notice: Esmeralda testnet was reset; entrants were asked to republish templates and update their submission versions where applicable. Earlier recordings document their capture dates. November 3 source review: the creator’s October 8 Bluesky announcement includes a short animated concept illustration and an illustrated reply. Neither depicts application interaction; the existing concept walkthrough remains labeled accordingly.
creator: Ongchi
cardSummary: Concept for a private trick-or-treat game where saying “Ootlejuice” three times summons Ootle.
